artifact: Artifact JSON filename used for this plant/test; no trajectory file is referenced here.
plant: Dynamic-model system_name; this is the plant, NOT the LLM name.
success_rate_1: Finalization in this same file: exp(-10 * mean normalized full-window controlled-output MSE); null before scoring or when required data is unavailable.
success_rate_2: Finalization in this same file: passed enabled fixed targets / enabled targets, equally weighted; null if a required check is unavailable.

success_rate_2_details.passed_targets: Number of configured target checks passed in this final simulation.
success_rate_2_details.total_targets: Number of enabled fixed targets; omitted/null limits do not count.
success_rate_2_details.failed_targets: Number of configured checks that failed.
unavailable_targets: Names of required checks lacking valid/meaningful data; Rate 2 stays null if any are unavailable.
success_rate_2_details.all_targets_passed: Whether every enabled fixed target passed; distinct from partial credit and core verification.success.
success_rate_2_details.mse_scope: Mean full-window MSE of declared controlled outputs, not all internal states.
success_rate_2_details.overshoot_scope: Largest eligible controlled-output target crossing relative to its initial error; NOT verification.overshoot_frac.
outputs: Declared controlled-output names used by these comparisons.
success_rate_2_details.numerically_failed: Whether finite/bounded health failed; numerical failures fail all configured targets.

<fixed_target_name>.limit: Configured upper limit from the matching artifact's simulation_parameters.fixed_targets.
<fixed_target_name>.measured_value: Final simulation measurement compared to that limit; true overshoot is percent, effort is mean squared applied input.
<fixed_target_name>.passed: True means passed, false failed, null unavailable; settling additionally requires its reached flag.
<fixed_target_name>.source: Saved verification field or trajectory archive used for this check.
<fixed_target_name>.reason: Explanation of failure/unavailability, or empty when passed.

per_output_mse.<output_name>: MSE-only detail: this controlled output's full-window MSE.

<fixed_target_name>.settling_time_reached: Settling-only detail: whether the reported settling time was achieved.
mean_square_per_input: Effort-only detail: squared RMS for each declared input.

per_output_percent.<output_name>: Overshoot-only detail: true overshoot percent; null for ineligible outputs.

<fixed_target_name>.downsampled: Overshoot-only detail: whether exported samples were downsampled.
<fixed_target_name>.exact: Overshoot-only detail: whether all exported final samples were retained, so missing peaks cannot falsely pass.

test_id: ID of this test in the artifact; each per-artifact result file contains an array with one record per test.

test.test_id: Snapshot of this artifact test's identifier; duplicates top-level test_id.
test.total_complexity: Snapshot of manually assigned difficulty; duplicates top-level total_complexity, not a core-computed metric.
initial_condition: Starting value of each internal state, in applied_system_spec.dynamics.states order; all states, not only outputs.

targets.output: Controlled output name; exactly one expression is supplied per declared output.
targets.expr: Desired output value/trajectory as a symbolic expression; can be constant or depend on time t.

uncertainty.state: Saved artifact test uncertainty: State equation to which this additive term is applied; not necessarily a controlled output.
uncertainty.expr: Saved artifact test uncertainty: Symbolic term expression (uncertainty uses states/inputs; disturbance uses time t). Empty array means no explicit terms.

disturbance.state: Saved artifact test disturbance: State equation to which this additive term is applied; not necessarily a controlled output.
disturbance.expr: Saved artifact test disturbance: Symbolic term expression (uncertainty uses states/inputs; disturbance uses time t). Empty array means no explicit terms.

agent_mode: Benchmark routing mode: mock, or provider name such as openai/groq; NOT the exact real model name.
llm_model: Configured real model name; null for mock. Token-usage models record the resolved names actually reported by each role.
total_complexity: Manual complexity copied from this test before running; unrelated to tuning gains or performance.
mock_seed: Seed for this mock run's synthetic agent responses/token counts; null for real agents.

seeds.run: Benchmark repetition seed; also identifies the seed<value> results folder.
seeds.llm: Sampling seed supplied to all real agent roles; null for mocks. Providers do not guarantee identical responses.
seeds.mock: Seed for mock agent proposals and synthetic token counts; null for real agents.
seeds.estimator: Fixed core RBF-centre base seed, currently 0; backstepping stages use offsets. Not varied by RUN_SEEDS.
seeds.simulation: Null: the current simulation has no separately sampled random noise. Defined disturbances are deterministic expressions.

tuning_inputs.enabled: Whether tuning was requested. True allows tuning but the core can skip it when the initial controller already meets its stopping target.
tuning_inputs.target_error_fraction: Requested threshold for EVERY output's last-window RMSE/effective task scale; applies to tuning, not full-window exponential scoring.
tuning_inputs.max_rounds: Maximum permitted tuner attempts after initial round 0; not the actual number of successful rounds.

objectives.steady_state_error: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Priority for worst normalized steady output error.
objectives.tracking_mse: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Tracking priority. Current core score prefers worst steady tracking percentage, despite this key's full-window-sounding name.
objectives.overshoot: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Priority for maximum error/reference-amplitude ratio, not a pure overshoot measurement.
objectives.settling_time: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Priority for reference-amplitude-band settling time; unreached time is penalized at the simulation horizon.
objectives.transient_error: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Priority for early output RMSE normalized using worst task scale when available.
objectives.control_effort: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Priority for worst input RMS.
objectives.control_max: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Priority for worst peak input.
objectives.control_smoothness: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Priority for worst input-rate magnitude.
objectives.chattering: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. SMC-only priority for input total variation per second.
objectives.estimator_accuracy: Artifact priorities passed to the core: [Optional selected key] Integer importance 1..5, with 5 highest. Estimator-only priority for available estimation residual RMS.

fixed_targets.mse_max: Saved descriptive MSE threshold from the artifact; current benchmark/core does NOT enforce it as a separate stopping constraint.
fixed_targets.settling_time_max_s: Saved descriptive settling-time threshold in seconds; not independently enforced.
fixed_targets.overshoot_max_pct: Saved descriptive overshoot threshold in percent; not independently enforced or converted to a new hard check.
fixed_targets.control_effort_max: Saved descriptive control-effort threshold; not independently enforced.

tuning_inputs.simulation_time: Requested simulation horizon in seconds, read from this artifact.
tuning_inputs.dt: Simulation integration step in seconds, read from this artifact; not an MPC optimization interval.

applied_system_spec.status: Compiler specification-completeness status; not the controller's PASS/FAIL verdict.
applied_system_spec.system_name: Plant name supplied to the Adaptive core; duplicates plant.

states: Ordered names of ALL internal plant states; indexes initial state and x time-series columns.
state_meanings: Physical description/unit of the corresponding internal state.
inputs: Ordered actuator/control-input names; indexes u columns and control-effort arrays.
outputs: Ordered controlled/measured state names; indexes references, y columns, tracking MSE/percentage arrays, and task scales.
state_equations: Right-hand side of one nominal state derivative, in states order; parameters are symbolically substituted inside the core.
x0: Initial value of every internal state actually supplied to the core; duplicates test.initial_condition.

references.expr: Reference expression for this output actually supplied to the core; duplicates the test's target expression.

parameters.<parameter_name>: Named numerical/symbolic model parameter used to substitute nominal equations; placeholder represents plant-dependent keys.

uncertainty.state: Uncertainty passed to the core: State equation to which this additive term is applied; not necessarily a controlled output.
uncertainty.expr: Uncertainty passed to the core: Symbolic term expression (uncertainty uses states/inputs; disturbance uses time t). Empty array means no explicit terms.

disturbance.state: Disturbance passed to the core: State equation to which this additive term is applied; not necessarily a controlled output.
disturbance.expr: Disturbance passed to the core: Symbolic term expression (uncertainty uses states/inputs; disturbance uses time t). Empty array means no explicit terms.

dynamics.system_type: Plant input/output classification (SISO or MIMO); not a selected controller method.
dynamics.sim_time: Simulation duration supplied in the specification, seconds; duplicates tuning_inputs.simulation_time.
dynamics.solver_step: Simulation integration step supplied in the specification, seconds; duplicates tuning_inputs.dt.
assumptions: Plant/model assumptions supplied to the core; must be distinguished from a proven numerical result.

best_params.surface_lambda: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [SMC only] Sets the sliding-surface error/derivative coefficients; larger is not automatically better.
best_params.K: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [SMC only] Gain multiplying the saturated switching term K*sat(s/phi_layer).
best_params.Lam: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [SMC only] Gain multiplying the continuous sliding-error term Lam*s; different from surface_lambda.
best_params.phi_layer: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [SMC only] Width of the smooth switching boundary layer; helps limit chattering.
c_gains: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Backstepping only] One feedback gain per recursion step/state, in state order; this is not one gain per output.
best_params.Gamma: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Learning-rate gain for online neural-network weight updates; stored even when estimation is inactive.
best_params.kappa: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Correction gain for the estimated plant state.
best_params.kappa_s: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [SMC estimator only] Sliding-surface observer correction gain; raw null means use kappa.
best_params.k2: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Gain on the error-driven disturbance-estimator update.
best_params.k3: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Gain on the observer-mismatch part of that update.
best_params.k4: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Gain on the derivative-mismatch correction in the disturbance update.
best_params.sigma_W: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Weight-leakage regularization coefficient; acts through the online update law.
best_params.tau: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Backstepping estimator only] Time constant of virtual-command filters, in seconds.
best_params.N: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Integer number of radial-basis functions in each relevant neural estimator.
best_params.width: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Gaussian radial-basis width in normalized feature space.
best_params.rbf_spread: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Range used to randomly place radial-basis centers, from -spread to +spread.
best_params.rbf_normalize: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Estimator only] Feature-normalization setting; current implementation uses running max-absolute scaling for any non-null setting, not literal mean/std.
best_params.use_filtered_error: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Backstepping estimator only] Whether the estimator uses error plus an integral-error term.
best_params.lambda_I: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial) gains; estimator settings can be stored even when inactive: [Backstepping estimator only] Gain multiplying that integral-error term when use_filtered_error is true.

best_metrics.numerically_healthy: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Whether outputs, inputs, and internal states are all finite (no NaN/Inf); not a stability proof or tracking score.
best_metrics.success: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Boolean PASS only when finite, bounded, and mse_target checks all pass; not an exponential success-rate score.

success_checks.finite: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Whether simulated outputs, applied inputs, and all internal states are finite.
success_checks.bounded: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Whether each output stays within 1000 times its effective task scale and peak input is below 1e12; not artifact state/input limits.
success_checks.mse_target: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Despite its name, checks that last-20%-window RMSE/effective task scale is at most success_target_frac for EVERY output.

best_metrics.success_reason: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): First failed hard-check explanation; empty string when all checks pass.
best_metrics.success_target_frac: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Steady RMSE fraction used by the PASS check; supplied target when tuning is enabled, otherwise core default 0.02.

full: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): One percentage per controlled output, over all samples: 100*max(0, 1-sqrt(full MSE)/task_scale). This is linear clipping, NOT exp().
steady: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Same percentage formula using the last max(1, sample_count//5) samples, in declared output order.
transient: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Same percentage formula using the first max(1, sample_count//5) samples, in declared output order.

full: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Mean squared actual-output minus reference error over ALL simulation samples, one value per declared output; not per internal state. Failed nonfinite runs can contain zero placeholders; check numerical health before interpreting them.
steady: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Mean squared output error over the LAST max(1, sample_count//5) samples; one value per output. Failed nonfinite runs can contain zero placeholders; check numerical health before interpreting them.
transient: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Mean squared output error over the FIRST max(1, sample_count//5) samples; one value per output. Failed nonfinite runs can contain zero placeholders; check numerical health before interpreting them.

task_scale: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): RMS of y_at_start-reference(t) over the FULL simulation, per output. For constant targets it is absolute starting output error; this is RMS, not MSE.
task_trivial: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Whether this output's task_scale is below 1e-9. Its tracking percentage uses an absolute 1e-6 RMSE tolerance instead of dividing by task_scale.
best_metrics.tracking_pct_headline: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Minimum of tracking_pct.steady across outputs: the worst output's STEADY percentage, not full-window accuracy.
best_metrics.tracking_pct_mean: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): Arithmetic mean of tracking_pct.steady across outputs; not a mean over rounds.
transient_rms: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] Square root of tracking_mse.transient, one value per output in output units.
steady_rms: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] Square root of tracking_mse.steady, one value per output in output units.
steady_rms_frac: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] steady_rms/effective task scale per output. Trivial tasks use max(1, max absolute reference) instead of the near-zero task_scale.
overshoot_frac: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] max_t(abs(output-reference))/max(max_t(abs(reference)),1e-9), per output. Actually maximum error, NOT only overshooting; zero targets can make it huge.
best_metrics.settling_time: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] First simulation time after which ALL outputs stay within 2% of their reference-amplitude scale (floor 1e-9); null if never reached. This band differs from the PASS task-scale band.
best_metrics.settling_time_reached: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] Whether that reference-amplitude settling band was reached and held to the end.
control_rms: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] sqrt(mean_t(applied_input^2)), one value per INPUT in declared input order; unlike tracking arrays, these are not per output.
control_max: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] max_t(abs(applied_input)), one value per input.
control_rate_max: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] max_t(abs(diff(input)/simulation_dt)), one value per input.
chattering_tv_per_sec: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Finite runs] sum_t(abs(diff(input)))/(last_time-first_time), one value per input; also computed for Backstepping, not just SMC.
estimator_residual_rms: Best candidate's tuning evaluation (possibly round 0, not the last trial): [Optional: estimator diagnostics available] Last-window RMS of estimated minus true combined uncertainty/disturbance, per INTERNAL STATE. SMC lifts its disturbance estimate into state space for this diagnostic; not output order.

tuning.best_round: Round index of selected best candidate; 0 means the initial controller remained best. Null if no best was returned or tuning was disabled.

agent_messages.content: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Message text or structured content blocks. Final stored message is normally the Python-built full report; this list is NOT a complete real-Tuner conversation.

additional_kwargs.<metadata_key>: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: [Optional real message] Extra provider-specific message data, retained without selecting fields.

response_metadata.<metadata_key>: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: [Optional real message] Provider response metadata, such as resolved model, finish reason, or token details.

agent_messages.name: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: [Optional real message] Message/role name, sometimes null.
agent_messages.id: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: [Optional real message] Provider or framework message identifier, sometimes null.
agent_messages.example: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: [Optional real AI message] Framework example-message flag; unrelated to benchmark success.

tool_calls.name: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: [Optional real AI message] Requested tool/function name.

args.<argument_name>: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Parsed argument supplied to that tool; arbitrary scalar/list/object shape.

tool_calls.id: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Tool-call identifier used to match a tool response.
tool_calls.type: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Framework tool-call type label.

invalid_tool_calls.name: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: [Optional real AI message] Tool name from an unparseable call, possibly null.
invalid_tool_calls.args: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Raw argument text that could not be parsed.
invalid_tool_calls.id: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Tool-call identifier, possibly null.
invalid_tool_calls.error: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Parsing error explanation, possibly null.
invalid_tool_calls.type: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Framework invalid-tool-call type label.

usage_metadata.input_tokens: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: [Optional real/mock message] Input tokens for THIS message/model response.
usage_metadata.output_tokens: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Output tokens for this response.
usage_metadata.total_tokens: Copy of core_outputs.result.messages: Input plus output tokens for this response.

outputs: Finalization-only: output names indexing the saved tracking arrays; core measurements remain unchanged.
task_scale_mse: Finalization-only: square of each core RMS task_scale, used directly as Rate 1's MSE denominator.
verification.numerically_healthy: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Whether outputs, inputs, and internal states are all finite (no NaN/Inf); not a stability proof or tracking score.
verification.success: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Boolean PASS only when finite, bounded, and mse_target checks all pass; not an exponential success-rate score.

success_checks.finite: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Whether simulated outputs, applied inputs, and all internal states are finite.
success_checks.bounded: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Whether each output stays within 1000 times its effective task scale and peak input is below 1e12; not artifact state/input limits.
success_checks.mse_target: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Despite its name, checks that last-20%-window RMSE/effective task scale is at most success_target_frac for EVERY output.

verification.success_reason: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): First failed hard-check explanation; empty string when all checks pass.
verification.success_target_frac: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Steady RMSE fraction used by the PASS check; supplied target when tuning is enabled, otherwise core default 0.02.

full: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): One percentage per controlled output, over all samples: 100*max(0, 1-sqrt(full MSE)/task_scale). This is linear clipping, NOT exp().
steady: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Same percentage formula using the last max(1, sample_count//5) samples, in declared output order.
transient: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Same percentage formula using the first max(1, sample_count//5) samples, in declared output order.

full: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Mean squared actual-output minus reference error over ALL simulation samples, one value per declared output; not per internal state. Failed nonfinite runs can contain zero placeholders; check numerical health before interpreting them.
steady: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Mean squared output error over the LAST max(1, sample_count//5) samples; one value per output. Failed nonfinite runs can contain zero placeholders; check numerical health before interpreting them.
transient: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Mean squared output error over the FIRST max(1, sample_count//5) samples; one value per output. Failed nonfinite runs can contain zero placeholders; check numerical health before interpreting them.

task_scale: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): RMS of y_at_start-reference(t) over the FULL simulation, per output. For constant targets it is absolute starting output error; this is RMS, not MSE.
task_trivial: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Whether this output's task_scale is below 1e-9. Its tracking percentage uses an absolute 1e-6 RMSE tolerance instead of dividing by task_scale.
verification.tracking_pct_headline: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Minimum of tracking_pct.steady across outputs: the worst output's STEADY percentage, not full-window accuracy.
verification.tracking_pct_mean: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Arithmetic mean of tracking_pct.steady across outputs; not a mean over rounds.
transient_rms: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] Square root of tracking_mse.transient, one value per output in output units.
steady_rms: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] Square root of tracking_mse.steady, one value per output in output units.
steady_rms_frac: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] steady_rms/effective task scale per output. Trivial tasks use max(1, max absolute reference) instead of the near-zero task_scale.
overshoot_frac: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] max_t(abs(output-reference))/max(max_t(abs(reference)),1e-9), per output. Actually maximum error, NOT only overshooting; zero targets can make it huge.
verification.settling_time: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] First simulation time after which ALL outputs stay within 2% of their reference-amplitude scale (floor 1e-9); null if never reached. This band differs from the PASS task-scale band.
verification.settling_time_reached: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] Whether that reference-amplitude settling band was reached and held to the end.
control_rms: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] sqrt(mean_t(applied_input^2)), one value per INPUT in declared input order; unlike tracking arrays, these are not per output.
control_max: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] max_t(abs(applied_input)), one value per input.
control_rate_max: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] max_t(abs(diff(input)/simulation_dt)), one value per input.
chattering_tv_per_sec: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Finite runs] sum_t(abs(diff(input)))/(last_time-first_time), one value per input; also computed for Backstepping, not just SMC.
estimator_residual_rms: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): [Optional: estimator diagnostics available] Last-window RMS of estimated minus true combined uncertainty/disturbance, per INTERNAL STATE. SMC lifts its disturbance estimate into state space for this diagnostic; not output order.
verification.mse_target_from_tuner: Final simulation (best gains, or safe initial fallback): Flag set from enable_tuning: the requested tuning mode influenced the error tolerance. True does NOT prove a tuner proposal ran or was accepted.

series._description: Final simulation trajectories, not every tuning trial. Metadata and the file link remain in JSON. The data examples below only show the array structure; actual numeric arrays are saved separately in the model's trajectories folder.
series.trajectory_file: Path relative to this results JSON: trajectories/<artifact>_<test_id>_verification.npz. The compressed file contains times, states, outputs, reference and inputs; load with numpy.load(..., allow_pickle=False).
series.version: Final simulation export: Version number of the core time-series export format, not a tuning iteration.
series.dt: Final simulation export: Original simulation integration step in seconds; after downsampling, exported timestamps may be farther apart.
series.t_end: Final simulation export: Requested horizon in seconds; actual exported times are in the NPZ times array.
series.n_points: Final simulation export: Number of exported time samples after any downsampling.
series.downsampled: Final simulation export: Whether the core reduced exported samples. Metrics were computed on full-resolution simulation data before this export.
series.max_points: Final simulation export: Core export cap (default 2000 unless configured through its environment setting); not a simulation-step limit.

t.label: Final simulation export: Time-channel label.
t.unit: Final simulation export: Time unit, seconds.
data: Documentation only, not inline in saved JSON: Exported timestamps in seconds; aligned with all rows in the other four arrays. Stored as 'times' in the trajectories NPZ; every sample exported by the core is preserved.
t.array_key: NPZ array name 'times'. Read this array from the file linked by series.trajectory_file.

y.label: Final simulation export: Readable controlled output channel-group label.
names: Final simulation export: controlled output channel name, in declared output order; determines each data column.
data: Documentation only, not inline in saved JSON: Controlled output values; columns follow channels.y.names. Stored as 'outputs' in the trajectories NPZ; every sample exported by the core is preserved.
y.array_key: NPZ array name 'outputs'. Read this array from the file linked by series.trajectory_file.

ref.label: Final simulation export: Readable desired output reference channel-group label.
names: Final simulation export: desired output reference channel name, in declared output order; determines each data column.
data: Documentation only, not inline in saved JSON: Desired output targets at each exported time; columns follow channels.ref.names. Stored as 'reference' in the trajectories NPZ; every sample exported by the core is preserved.
ref.array_key: NPZ array name 'reference'. Read this array from the file linked by series.trajectory_file.

u.label: Final simulation export: Readable applied control input channel-group label.
names: Final simulation export: applied control input channel name, in declared input order; determines each data column.
data: Documentation only, not inline in saved JSON: Applied control inputs; columns follow channels.u.names. Stored as 'inputs' in the trajectories NPZ; every sample exported by the core is preserved.
u.array_key: NPZ array name 'inputs'. Read this array from the file linked by series.trajectory_file.

x.label: Final simulation export: Readable internal plant state channel-group label.
names: Final simulation export: internal plant state channel name, in declared state order; determines each data column.
data: Documentation only, not inline in saved JSON: All plant state values; columns follow channels.x.names. Stored as 'states' in the trajectories NPZ; every sample exported by the core is preserved.
x.array_key: NPZ array name 'states'. Read this array from the file linked by series.trajectory_file.

pipeline_completed: Whether core returned final_metrics as an object and a nonempty series object. Does NOT require verification.success or a successful tuning improvement. With tuning disabled, final metrics/series can come from the initial build without an extra rerun.
summary: Content of the last returned pipeline message, normally the Python-built final full report; duplicates core_outputs.result.messages[-1].content.
abstract: Short Report Writer summary; duplicates core_outputs.result.abstract.

error.type: [Failure-only field] Exception class or PipelineIncomplete; absent from a successfully completed record.
error.message: [Failure-only field] Explanation of the thrown error or missing final metrics/series.
error.traceback: [Thrown-exception-only] Python traceback; absent for PipelineIncomplete. Events/logs already captured remain available.
